main_text.p: est à גיר, quod idem significat, cum prothesi א.
אנם Ch. Tristari, Contristari, Jobi 30.25. Ab Hebraeo אנם.
אנם Ch. Stagnum. Plur. אנמין, emph. אנמיא.

אגן אגנתא · אגנא · אגן Chald. & Syr. Crater, Scyphus, Phiala. Plur. אגנין Phialae, emph. אגניא Foveae, Lacus, quod sint sicuti crateres, scribit Kimchi, Jud. 4. 11. Syr. אגנא Hydriae, Joh. 2. 6. Constr. אגני Orbes, 1.Reg. 7.41.
אוגנא Ch. Idem, אוגנא דסיהרא Crater lunae, seu Circulus lunae, Cantic. 7.3. Alii, Sicut Phiala rotunda.
אגן Syr. Certamen. Ex Graeco ἀγὼν.
אגר Ch. & Syr. Mercede contraxit, conduxit. Ex Pah. ואגרני Et mercede conduxit me, Judic. 18. 4. Hithp. Ch. אתגר vel אתגר ex Ithpeh. Mercede conduci: Item Mercedem accipere, Persolvi; Syr.
אגר Negotiari, Lucrari negociando, Mercari, Mercaturam exercere, Quaestum facere, Ad quaestum vel lucrum uti, vel abuti. Alii referunt ad תגר.
אגירא · אגיר Ch. & Syr. Mercenarius: Merces, Praemium, Eccl. 1.3.
אגרא · אגר Ch. & Syr. Merces, Praemium: Item, Scipio, Baculus, 2.Sam. 3.29. Plur. אגריא Praemia, Genef. 49.1. Jon.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldaic and Syriac words are reproduced as best legible; several vocalised forms and the Greek word ἀγὼν are uncertain. Heavy Hebrew and Syriac type; some letters in the Syriac entries may be imperfect.
